inputs.name: registerAuditCommand.program
inputs.description: The commander Command the audit subcommand is attached to. It matters only when registerAuditCommand calls program.command('audit [path]') on it, and the function neither validates nor stores it, so callers must pass a Command that can create subcommands.

outputs.name: registerAuditCommand
outputs.description: The function has no return statement, so the value is always undefined and carries no data. Its effect is on program: the audit [path] subcommand gets the options set in audit.ts (--coverage, --profile, --json, --clean-code, --gate, --dry-run, --refresh), whatever analyticsOptions() adds to it, and an action that calls runAudit(path, options).
